notes_for_editor: Only one source names this tower: a one-line Forest Lookouts entry with no height, material, status or staffing. Two searches found no register, Forest Service or newspaper record of a Tate tower in Apalachicola National Forest. The USFS handbook names four towers on the Wakulla district and none at Wilma; it does not mention a Tate tower, so it is used only for the forest's CCC context. Tate's Hell State Forest is a different state property; the search turned up nothing sourced to use in the story. Record county and agency match the source. Status and access stay unknown.
